title: Công trình Garden theo mẫu khuông: máy xay, thùng ủ, vòi tưới, cửa hàng (9 mẫu × 4)
decisions: Decision 056 (owner, 2026-11-09): backdrops, plot skins and light effects change per skin, so the buildings standing on the scene need the same concept or they look out of place. One sheet per skin, each cell = the game's current building re-themed (attached as a game-art hint in the same order). Cells are named <building>_<skin>; the game uses them for the tier / zone wearing that skin once the skin is listed in SKIN_BUILDING_READY (src/core/config/plotSkins.ts). Sizes are the current building canvases (bld_feed_mill 260x260, bld_composter 220x200, bld_sprinkler 120x200, bld_shop_garden 260x240).
